title_jp: クリスマスとお{正月|しょうがつ}
context: Wednesday 16 December: {由紀|ゆき} messages アルちゃん after her company's year-end party. They compare Christmas and New Year in Spain and Japan, and she asks whether he'll spend the 24th with レン.
scene: Wednesday night. {由紀|ゆき} has just left her office year-end party. You compare Christmas in Spain and Japan, until she asks about レン.

phrases.jp: {東京|とうきょう}は{鷹ノ原|たかのはら}ほど{雪|ゆき}が{降らない|ふらない}。
phrases.en: Tokyo doesn't get as much snow as {鷹ノ原|たかのはら}.
phrases.note: A は B ほど + negative = A isn't as … as B.

phrases.jp: {国|くに}によって{全然|ぜんぜん}{違う|ちがう}ね。
phrases.en: It's totally different depending on the country.
phrases.note: 〜によって = depending on. Handy whenever you compare.

phrases.jp: スペインでは、どうやって{祝う|いわう|to celebrate|3}の？
phrases.en: How do you celebrate in Spain?
phrases.note: {祝|いわ}う: holidays, birthdays, success. The noun is お{祝|いわ}い.

phrases.jp: {涙|なみだ|tears|3}が{出る|でる}ほど{笑った|わらった}。
phrases.note: Verb + ほど: 'to the point of'.

phrases.jp: {良いお年を|よいおとしを|have a good New Year|4}！
phrases.note: Said the last time you see someone before New Year. After 1 January: あけましておめでとう.

dialogue_setting: LINE, Wednesday night. {由紀|ゆき} is on the train home in Tokyo; you're under the kotatsu in {鷹ノ原|たかのはら}.

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: {忘年会|ぼうねんかい|year-end party|3}{終わった|おわった}〜！{部長|ぶちょう}のカラオケ、{最後|さいご}まで{死ぬ|しぬ}ほど{長かった|ながかった}ｗ
dialogue.en: Year-end party's over! The manager's karaoke was deadly long right to the end lol

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: お{疲れ|つかれ}ｗ スペインは{今|いま}、クリスマスの{準備|じゅんび|preparations|4}で{忙しい|いそがしい}{時期|じき|time, season, period|3}だよ。
dialogue.en: Good job surviving lol. In Spain this is the busy season, getting ready for Christmas.

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: {日本|にほん}のクリスマスって、スペインほど{大事|だいじ}じゃないでしょ？
dialogue.en: Christmas in Japan isn't as big a deal as in Spain, right?

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: うん。スペインは{家族|かぞく}で{過ごす|すごす|to spend (time)|3}けど、
dialogue.en: Yeah. In Spain you spend it with your family, but…

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {日本|にほん}は{恋人|こいびと|boyfriend/girlfriend|3}の{日|ひ}って{感じ|かんじ}。
dialogue.en: in Japan it feels like a day for couples.

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: その{代わり|かわり}、お{正月|しょうがつ}は{家族|かぞく}の{行事|ぎょうじ|event, custom|3}！{逆|ぎゃく}だよねｗ
dialogue.en: Instead, New Year is the family event! It's the other way round lol

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.en: So, the 24th with レン? lol

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: まだ{何|なに}も{決めてない|きめてない}よ。{誘う|さそう}{勇気|ゆうき}がない…
dialogue.en: Nothing's decided yet. I don't have the guts to ask him…

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: {誘える|さそえる}ほど{仲良く|なかよく|on good terms, close|3}なってるじゃん！{絶対|ぜったい}{喜ぶ|よろこぶ|to be happy, glad|4}って
dialogue.en: You're close enough to ask him! He'll definitely be happy, I'm telling you

listening.title: {防災無線|ぼうさいむせん}

lines.jp: {鷹ノ原町|たかのはらまち}からお{知らせ|しらせ}です。{年末年始|ねんまつねんし|the New Year holidays|3}のゴミの{収集|しゅうしゅう|collection|2}について。
lines.en: A notice from {鷹ノ原|たかのはら} town about rubbish collection over the New Year holidays.

lines.jp: 12{月|がつ}30{日|にち}から1{月|がつ}3{日|か}まで、{収集|しゅうしゅう|collection|2}はお{休み|やすみ}です。
lines.en: From 30 December to 3 January, there will be no collection.

listening.question: ゴミの{収集|しゅうしゅう}がないのは、いつですか。
listening.explain: 12{月|がつ}30{日|にち}から1{月|がつ}3{日|か}まで: no collection from 30 Dec to 3 Jan.

grammar.form: degree: plain form + ほど ({死|し}ぬほど, {涙|なみだ}が{出|で}るほど, {誘|さそ}えるほど) · not as … as: A は B ほど + negative (スペインほど{大事|だいじ}じゃない)
grammar.explanation: ほど marks a degree: 'to the point that…'. {死|し}ぬほど is everyday exaggeration, 'like crazy'. With a negative it compares: A は B ほど〜ない = A isn't as … as B. For 'more than', use より, not ほど.

examples.jp: {今日|きょう}は{手|て}が{痛い|いたい}ほど{寒い|さむい}。
examples.en: It's so cold today my hands hurt.

examples.jp: {大阪|おおさか}のお{好み焼き|このみやき|okonomiyaki|4}ほどうまいものはない！
examples.en: Nothing's as good as Osaka okonomiyaki! (says {健太|けんた})

quiz.question: {東京|とうきょう}の{冬|ふゆ}は、{長野|ながの}＿＿{寒くない|さむくない}。
quiz.en: Winter in Tokyo isn't as cold as in Nagano.
quiz.explain: Negative comparison: A は B ほど〜ない.

quiz_more.question: もう{歩けない|あるけない}＿＿{疲れた|つかれた}。
quiz_more.en: I'm so tired I can't walk any more.
quiz_more.explain: Plain form + ほど: tired to the point of not being able to walk.

quiz_more.question: {今年|ことし}は{去年|きょねん}＿＿{雪|ゆき}が{多い|おおい}。
quiz_more.en: This year there's more snow than last year.
quiz_more.explain: A positive comparison needs より. ほど only compares with a negative.

kanji.where: On the {居酒屋|いざかや} sign in the photo {由紀|ゆき} sends from her party.
kanji.breakdown: 飲み drinking + {放題|ほうだい} as much as you like ({放|ほう} let go + {題|だい} topic) → drink freely.
kanji.related: {食べ放題|たべほうだい} = all-you-can-eat. Usually with a time limit: 2{時間|じかん}{飲み放題|のみほうだい}.

tip.title: {忘年会|ぼうねんかい} season
tip.body: In December almost every company, club and group of friends holds a {忘年会|ぼうねんかい}, a party to 'forget the year'. The boss may say tonight is {無礼講|ぶれいこう} (no rank, anything goes), but nobody really believes it. As people leave, they say {良|よ}いお{年|とし}を.

challenge.prompt: {由紀|ゆき}: 「スペインと{比べて|くらべて}、{日本|にほん}のクリスマスってどう？」 Tell her Japan's Christmas isn't as big an event as Spain's.
pieces: {日本|にほん}のクリスマスは、
challenge.model_answer: {日本|にほん}のクリスマスは、スペインほど{大きな|おおきな}イベントじゃないよ。
challenge.explanation: The topic ({日本|にほん}のクリスマスは) comes first, then what you compare it with + ほど. The sentence must end in a negative (じゃない) for ほど to mean 'not as … as'. よ adds a friendly 'you know'.
challenge.hint: A は B ほど + negative

vocab.note: {忘|わす}れる forget + {年|とし} year + {会|かい} party.
{準備|じゅんび}する = to prepare. 〜の{準備|じゅんび}をする.
{忙|いそが}しい{時期|じき} = busy season. Not a clock time.
Time, holidays, a day. Money is {使|つか}う.
{年中行事|ねんちゅうぎょうじ} = yearly customs, like {七五三|しちごさん} or お{正月|しょうがつ}.
{仲|なか} relationship + {良|よ}い good. {仲良|なかよ}くなる = become close.
Shows happiness at something. {喜|よろこ}んで! = gladly!
{誕生日|たんじょうび}を{祝|いわ}う. The noun: お{祝|いわ}い.
{涙|なみだ}が{出|で}る = tears come. Water radical on the left.

kanji_study.parts: 壴 a drum on a stand + 口 mouth → drumming and singing at a festival: joy.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 嘉 (praise, rare): 喜 ends in 口 at the bottom.

kanji_study.parts: 日 sun + 取 take → taking the very top, like the sun at noon: most.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 量 (amount): 量 has 里 below, 最 has 取 take.
